en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that
[19:5] And surely I fear my relatives after me
’ – Meaning that he (Zakariyya<sup>as</sup>) did not have an inheritor for himself<sup>as</sup> until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Granted for him<sup>as</sup> after the old age’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin would read, ‘. . .
I am afraid for my dependents after me,’ [19:6] meaning that he had no heirs until Allah granted him (an heir) after his becoming very old.’”
